metrics.source: only original selected action-before/after public image[7][7][3], direction, literal mission, original selected action 0..6, reward and terminal; action-specific and source hashing
metrics.target_visible_anywhere: literal original pickup mission target type/color exact match in before-action 7x7; count frames, distinct public before hashes, episodes with exposure
metrics.target_front: literal exact target at before public image[3][5]; count original frames, distinct source public before hashes, exposures, selected action3 and real after disappearance separately
metrics.other_interaction: public locked door front and selected toggle action5 vs actually opened door; never infer usable key/inventory
metrics.navigation: counts selected left/right turns 0,1, forward2, pickup3, drop4, toggle5, done6; report actual selected action histogram for all 9 roles and four families. No 'forward movement' assertion from selected action2.
metrics.stalls: same before and after original full public SHA; report observed no change per action, including forward/toggle
metrics.goal: original positive reward and true terminated only; separate DoorKey from three unfamiliar pickup families
metrics.no_counterfactual: no estimates for actions not taken; within-policy selected actual outcomes only; public contexts not geographic regions
metrics.attribution: distinguish target never visible vs target visible not approached vs target front but no pickup attempted vs attempted pickup without real effect vs successful actual goal; do not assert learned causality or native improvements
metrics.equal_information_caveat: comparators act on their own selected historical state; cross-policy differences are descriptive and not paired counterfactual causal comparisons
